notes:
Account overview:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primarily B2B2C workflow: instrumenting product events, building in-app guidance and help, generating summaries for product managers.
- Initially landed on Hosted API to speed prototyping (chat + embeddings). After stable POC, moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and isolation.

Key contacts:
- CPO: Lena Ortiz (technical buyer, cares about latency and determinism)
- Head of Platform: Marco Chen (infrastructure owner, wants VPC + KMS integration)
- Procurement: Dana King (handles legal/commit signoffs)
- AE (owner): Jordan Miles. SE: Priya Desai.

POC / Demo history:
- 2025-12-02: Intro demo (Hosted API) — focus on chat flow and contextual embeddings. Positive reaction to streaming and function-call features.
- 2026-01-15: POC kickoff using Hosted API; baseline latency 100-150ms p50 on dev region; embedding quality tests passed.
- 2026-01-30: Canary demo for internal product teams — impressed with prompt-templates and reranking features.
- 2026-02-18: Dedicated sizing workshop with Priya: discussed target throughput 600 QPS for embeddings service, 250 concurrent chat sessions (p99 latency target <350ms).
- 2026-02-25: Pricing review call with AE + SE + procurement. Asked for committed monthly vGPU equivalent, burst policy, and overage pricing.

Requirements summary (from technical and procurement):
- Workloads: mix of embeddings-heavy search (evening peaks), chat assistant in-app (interactive), nightly batch reranking for personalization.
- Latency SLOs: chat p99 <350ms, embeddings p95 <450ms.
- Throughput: sustained ~300 embeddings QPS with 3x burst to 900 for marketing campaigns.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market — want mechanism to cap monthly spend and favorable overage tiers. Looking for ramp schedule to align with usage in first 12 months.
- Model preferences: prefer open models supported by Redwood; want option to fall back to smaller/quantized variants during high load.
- Routing / fallback: multi-region routing (NA primary, EU for residency-critical accounts).
- Security: SSO (Okta), SOC2 compliance, KMS integration for key wrapping, audit logs for all requests, 13-month log retention, data residency in US + EU options.

Pricing/packaging conversations summary:
- Current ask: dedicated commit equivalent of 8 reserved vGPU units monthly with 2x burst and defined overage bands. Procurement asked for examples of ramp schedules (0-3 months 50% commit, 4-6 months 75%, 7-12 months 100%) and an option to pre-buy credits for burst.
- AE proposed a 12-mo commit with tiered discounts at $/vGPU-hr and a 90-day ramp credit for first quarter. SE clarified autoscaling behavior and what counts toward commit (scheduled batch vs. ephemeral burst).
- Outstanding: define exact measurement window for burst (minute-level vs. hour-level), overage price per vGPU-hr, and whether cached KV/prefix cache reduces commit billing.

Legal & compliance notes:
- Procurement flagged data residency and right-to-audit clauses. Need Redwood standard DPA + addendum for EU residency.
- Security questionnaire: completed SOC2 attestation uploaded to shared drive. Need KMS integration appendix in MSA.

- Jordan to send revised term sheet by 2026-03-04 with: commit tiers, explicit burst window definition, overage tiers, ramp schedule examples, EDU for POC credits.
- Priya to deliver detailed performance test plan and expected sizing spreadsheet by 2026-03-08.
- Procurement (Dana) to confirm internal approval timeline (expects final sign-off by 2026-04-15 if pricing approved).
